# Richmond Hill Heating & Cooling

> Richmond Hill Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Richmond Hill, York Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (905) 884-7163  |  Email: contact@richmondhillheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://richmondhillheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Richmond Hill, Markham, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
